loginFirstRunHint: New here? Your panel URL and password are on the installer’s green “Ready” card. Lost the URL path? See docs/troubleshooting.md in the repo.
downloadSourceHint: Choose a node to pull the OpenVPN profile from.
noNodesAvailable: No active nodes available for download.
subIsOpenvpn: This is an OpenVPN panel. Use 'Get Config' in the user popup to download a .ovpn file per node — OpenVPN clients don't use HTTP subscription links.
ovpnInvalid: Panel received HTML or invalid content instead of an OpenVPN profile. Check panel URLPATH/API build and node selection.
modal_maxLoginsHint: Devices connected at the same time. 0 = unlimited.
userCreateFailed: Could not create the user. The name might already exist.
nodeBundleHint: Printed by the node installer (“Bundle”) and its --json output. Fills every field below.
nodeBundleInvalid: That does not look like a node bundle (ovnode://name@host:port?key=…&tls=…).
nodeBundleMissing: The bundle is missing the name, address or key.
nodeTestFailed: Test failed — is the node reachable at this address?
nodeNameHint: Must match the --name given to the node installer, exactly.
nodeAddressHint: Public IP or hostname of the node server.
nodePortHint: Sync API port (2083 default) — not the OpenVPN port.
nodeKeyHint: Paste the API key from the node installer summary.
nodeUseTlsHint: On when the node used self-signed or Let’s Encrypt; off only when the node used TLS None.
nodeCountryHint: Leave on auto-detect unless the lookup is wrong — a manual pick always wins.
keyKeepExistingHint: Leave blank to keep the current key
errorCreatingAdmin: An error occurred while creating the admin.
errorUpdatingAdmin: An error occurred while updating the admin.
notifEmpty: No active notifications. All systems nominal.
noUsersBody: Create a user to start handing out VPN access. They'll appear here with live status.
noNodesBody: Add your first OVNode to get started.
loadErrorDetail: We had trouble reaching the server.
nodePageSubtitle: Manage the OVNode servers this panel controls.
nodeEmptyBody: Add your first OVNode to start. If a node will not connect, the Health page explains the usual causes.
nodeConfirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? Its users and configs are removed too. This cannot be undone.
nodeRequestFailed: The panel could not reach the node.
nodeNoStatus: No live status yet — check the node.
nodeKeepCurrentHint: Leave empty to keep the current value.
nodeSettingsNote: Saving any setting here reloads the VPN and briefly interrupts connected users.
nodeDnsHint: DNS servers pushed to VPN clients. Leave a box empty to keep the current value.
nodePortsHint: Extra ports the node opens for the VPN, like 443,8443. Leave empty to close them again.
nodeRestartHint: Restarts OpenVPN on the node. Connected users drop and reconnect.
nodeRenewCertHint: Issues a fresh OpenVPN server certificate and restarts OpenVPN. Clients reconnect automatically; use it when the certificate is near expiry.
nodeUpdateHint: Asks the node to update itself. Docker nodes must be updated from the host instead.
nodeDownloadHint: Download every OpenVPN profile from this node as a ZIP file.
nodeToggleHint: A disabled node stays in the panel but is no longer used for new users.
nodeOpenVpnStopped: The node reports OpenVPN is not running.
nodeProtocolHint: UDP is usually faster; TCP gets through stricter networks.
nodeDefaultsNote: New nodes default to UDP — change it if the installer used TCP.
nodeNameRequired: Enter a name for this node.
nodeAddressRequired: Enter the node's public IP address or hostname.
nodePortInvalid: Port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
nodeOvpnPortInvalid: VPN port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
setupNodeOwnerOnly: Only the panel owner can add nodes. Ask the owner to connect one, then press Refresh.
setupBannerAdminBody: Your account has no users yet — create one to hand out VPN access.
settingsSubtitle: Everyday options first. Advanced tools live one tab away.
settingsAdvancedIntro: Rarely changed or riskier settings. Handle with care.
settingsOwnerOnlyBody: These settings can only be changed by the panel owner.
settingsTlsDesc: Certificate status for the panel itself
settingsTlsLoadError: Could not read the TLS status.
settingsTlsRestartRequired: A new certificate is waiting. Restart the panel to activate it.
settingsTlsRestartToApply: Restart the panel to activate the new certificate.
settingsTlsRestartConfirm: The panel will disconnect for a few seconds while it restarts, then come back automatically. Continue?
settingsTlsRestarting: Restarting the panel… this page will reconnect automatically in a few seconds.
settingsTlsRestartUnknown: The panel did not answer yet. Wait a few seconds, then refresh this page.
settingsTlsRestartFailed: Could not restart the panel automatically. Restart it from the server console.
settingsTlsUploadHint: Upload the private key and its certificate as PEM files (.pem, .key, .crt or .cer, each under 1 MB). The key must match the certificate, and the certificate must not be expired.
settingsTlsFileTooLarge: Each file must be smaller than 1 MB.
settingsTlsBothFiles: Choose both the private key and the certificate files first.
settingsTlsSelfSignedHint: Creates a new certificate valid for 10 years for this server's primary IP. Because no public authority signs it, browsers show a security warning until you accept it.
settingsTlsSelfSignedConfirm: A new self-signed certificate will replace the current one. Browsers will warn that the connection is not trusted until you accept it manually. Continue?
settingsTlsLetsEncryptHint: Requests a free, trusted certificate. The domain must already point to this server, and port 80 must be reachable from the internet. This can take up to two minutes.
settingsTlsEmailHint: Optional. Let's Encrypt uses it for expiry notices; a temporary address is used when it is empty.
settingsTlsUseIp: Request a certificate for this server's IP address
settingsTlsUseIpHint: Uses the server's primary IP and issues a short-lived certificate.
settingsTlsRenewing: Requesting… this can take up to two minutes. Keep this tab open.
settingsTlsRenewLost: No answer from the server. The request can take up to two minutes — refresh the status above before retrying.
settingsTlsRequestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
adminsSubtitle: Panel operators. Disabling an admin signs them out everywhere immediately.
adminsCannotDisableSelf: You cannot change your own admin status.
adminsConfirmEnable: Enable admin "{{name}}" so they can log in again?
adminsConfirmDisable: Disable admin "{{name}}"? Every active session will be signed out immediately.
adminsSessionsHint: Devices currently signed in as this admin. Signing out revokes every session immediately.
adminsConfirmSignOut: Sign out every device for "{{name}}"? They will need to log in again.
adminTelegramHint: Numeric Telegram user ID. Empty = no bot access.
auditSubtitle: Who changed what, and when. Entries are scoped to the admins you can see.
setupSubtitle: Three quick steps to get your panel ready for real users.
setupStepNodeDesc: Nodes are the servers users actually connect to. Add this server, or connect a remote one.
setupStepUserDesc: A user gets a personal config they import into the OpenVPN app. Expiry and traffic limits live here.
setupStepConfigDesc: In Users, press the download icon on the user row, pick a node, and save the .ovpn file. Import it into any OpenVPN client — that is the whole connection flow.
setupSameServerHint: Same server as OVManager? The installer’s Ready card already printed a ready-to-paste OVNode command with the API key — run that instead, then paste the ovnode:// bundle into Nodes → Add Node.
setupNodeInactive: A node was added but is not answering yet. Open Nodes and test the connection.
setupAllDone: All set! Your panel is ready.
setupAllDoneBody: Node, user and config are in place. You can close this page.
setupSkipNote: Skipping hides the reminder on Home. The wizard stays available at /setup.
setupSkipped: Setup wizard hidden. Open /setup any time to return.
setupLoadErrorDetail: The panel could not read its own counters. Try again in a moment.
setupBannerBody: {{done}} of 3 steps done — add a node, create a user, download a config.
maintenanceDesc: Background jobs run automatically. Trigger them on demand below.
subscriptionLinkDesc: Base URL and path used by user VPN subscription links.
loadFailedMessage: Some services are unavailable. Try again in a moment.
noUsersOnlineDesc: Users will appear here when they connect.
noNodesDesc: Add a node to see its live status on the map and table.
botDesc: From @BotFather. Operators use the menu and typed search — /start is the only command. Leave blank to keep the current token.
botEncryptKeyMissingDesc: BOT_ENCRYPT_KEY is not set in your .env file. Bot tokens cannot be saved without it.
loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage your VPN fleet.
settingsDefaultsDesc: New user defaults used by the Telegram bot
settingsDisplayDesc: Timezone used for all date and time displays
defaultsDesc: Used as the Standard plan when an operator creates a user from the Telegram bot.
defaultDevicesHint: Simultaneous logins allowed for each new user. 0 = unlimited.
settingsGeneralDesc: Panel URL path and subscription link prefix
updateUpToDate: You are running the latest version.
updateWarning: The panel will restart briefly while it updates.
updateConfirm: The panel will restart briefly and may be unavailable for up to a minute. Continue?
updateStarted: Update started. The panel will restart shortly.
updateTimeout: The panel did not answer in time. Check the server logs.
updateRefused: The panel cannot start the update automatically.
settingsBotDesc: Telegram bot token, enable state and owner ID
settingsLoadErrorDetail: Could not reach the server. Check the panel connection.
pwaInstallDesc: Install OVManager on this device for a full-screen window.
pwaCertRequired: Install needs a trusted certificate — switch to Let's Encrypt, then reload.
healthSubtitle: Live checks across the panel, database, nodes and integrations.
healthRefreshFailed: Refresh failed — showing the previous results.
healthErrorBody: The health endpoint did not respond.
activityWillAppear: Activity will appear here after admin actions.
name: Name
settingsAlertsDesc: Which alerts to show and how often to refresh
notifyTelegramDesc: One daily Telegram summary of users expiring soon or out of traffic, plus an instant alert when a node goes down or comes back. Uses the bot token and owner ID from the Bot section.
notifyNodeDown: Node goes down or comes back
themeDesc: System follows your operating system preference.
languageDesc: Interface language. Persian switches the panel to RTL.
alertsDesc: Choose which alerts appear in the topbar bell and the dashboard strip.
activityDesc: Your latest actions on this panel.
notifUserOverQuotaDetail: Usage exceeded — will be disabled on next check
refreshDesc: How often the dashboard and notification bell poll for fresh data.
loginHeroTitle: One calm view of your VPN fleet.
loginHeroDesc: Monitor nodes, manage access, and resolve connection issues before they become incidents.
secureAccessTitle: Secure access to the control room
secureAccessDesc: Everything you need to keep OpenVPN users online.
loginFootnote: Access is limited to authorized administrators.
errorBoundaryDesc: An unexpected error occurred. Please try refreshing the page.
applyNodeSettings: Apply new VPN settings on the node
applyNodeSettingsHint: Re-writes OpenVPN protocol/port/tunnel on the node. Leave off to only update this panel record — works even when the node is offline.
nodeLogsEmpty: No log records at this level.
toggleStatusHint: Disable without deleting the record — node stops being used.
deleteNodeHint: Removes the node and its users from the panel. This cannot be undone.
undoFailed: Undo failed — user could not be restored.
accentDesc: Changes the brand color across the panel. Saved per browser.
sectionErrorTitle: This section could not be displayed
sectionErrorDesc: The rest of the page is still usable.
noMatchesBody: Try a different search term or clear the active filter.
confirmResetUsage: Reset all usage data for "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
confirmDeleteAdmin: Delete admin "{{name}}"? Their users will remain but become unassigned.
shortcutsHint: Type these anywhere except inside a field.
ownerTelegramIdHint: Your numeric Telegram user ID. After saving, open the bot and tap Start.
extendDaysHint: Added to the current expiry date.
extendTrafficHint: Added to the current quota. Leave 0 to keep quota.
extendEmpty: Enter days or traffic to add.
confirmBulkDelete: Delete {{count}} selected items? This cannot be undone.
cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own admin account.
restoreHint: Select a .db backup file to restore. This overwrites current data and asks for confirmation.
backupMustBeDb: Backup file must be a .db file.
backupAutoKeepHint: How many daily backups to keep (1–500). Older ones are removed.
backupAutoHint: Off by default. When enabled, the panel writes a database backup every day at this time and keeps only the newest N.
confirmRestoreFile: Restore from "{{name}}"? This will overwrite current data.
noBackupsBody: Create your first backup to protect panel data.
noAttentionDesc: No expiring, over-quota or disabled users right now.
tlsUnverified: Unverified TLS (self-signed) — no MITM protection. Switch the node to Let's Encrypt.
tlsPlainDetail: Plain HTTP — API key crosses the network in cleartext. Enable TLS on the node.
expiringSoonDesc: Access ends in the next 7 days.
noExpiringSoon: No users expire in the next 7 days.
topTalkersDesc: Users with the most traffic this week.
topTalkersEmpty: No traffic recorded in the last 7 days.
createUserDefaults: New users start with {{days}} days and {{count}} device(s) — change anything below.
createdNote: Hand the profile to the customer — the VPN config is generated on first download.
userTagHint: Optional — e.g. monthly, vip, reseller-a. Shown as a chip on the user row.
